67059384.title: Large language model
67059384.extract:
A large language model (LLM) is a language model trained with self-supervised machine learning on a vast amount of text.
LLMs can be used for language generation and other natural language processing tasks.

1226519.title: Natural-language understanding
1226519.extract: Natural-language understanding (NLU) is a subtopic of natural language processing that deals with machine reading comprehension.

5951.title: Chinese room
5951.extract: The Chinese room argument holds that a computer executing a program cannot have a mind, understanding, or consciousness, regardless of how intelligently it may behave.
